_readme: Samples the linter MUST flag. Each entry lists the tell id(s) it expects to trip (see lib/ai-tells.ts; 'heuristic:colons' and 'heuristic:too-short' are the two built-in heuristics). The eval fails if a sample trips nothing OR if an expected tell doesn't fire — a sample that flags for the wrong reason is a rotten sample. Add new entries whenever you add a pattern to lib/ai-tells.ts.
